user.title: Lil Wet Guys
user.description: Lil Wet Guys keeps a watering countdown for each of your plants. After setup, add each plant with the **Add plant** button on this integration's page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Lil Wet Guys is already set up. Add plants with the **Add plant** button on its integration page.

user.title: Add a plant
user.description: Choose a plant type to fill in its care details for you. You can change any of them on the next page.

data_description.name: How the plant appears on your dashboard, for example "Monstera by the window".
data_description.species: Pick **Other** if your plant isn't listed; you'll choose a drawing and fill in its care yourself.

details.title: {name}
details.description: Care details for {species}. The watering interval is for bright, indirect light; the light setting shortens it in direct sun and stretches it in lower light.

data_description.light: Direct sun ×0.75, bright indirect ×1, medium ×1.25, low ×1.5.
data_description.shape: Which cartoon to draw for this plant.
data_description.photo: Optional. Shown when you tap the plant on the dashboard.
data_description.last_watered: When you last watered it. The countdown starts from here.

sensors.name: Sensors (optional)
sensors.description: Link a room thermometer to get a warning when it's too cold or hot, or a soil moisture sensor to mark the plant as watered automatically.

data.moisture_jump: Moisture rise that counts as watering

data_description.moisture_jump: A rise of this many percentage points within an hour marks the plant as watered.

reconfigure.title: Edit {name}
reconfigure.description: Changing the plant type doesn't overwrite the care details below. To reset the countdown, use the plant's **Last watered** entity or its **Watered** button.

data_description.light: Direct sun ×0.75, bright indirect ×1, medium ×1.25, low ×1.5.
data_description.shape: Only used when the plant type is Other.

sensors.name: Sensors (optional)
sensors.description: Link a room thermometer to get a warning when it's too cold or hot, or a soil moisture sensor to mark the plant as watered automatically.

data.moisture_jump: Moisture rise that counts as watering

data_description.moisture_jump: A rise of this many percentage points within an hour marks the plant as watered.

error.temp_range: The lowest temperature has to be below the highest.
error.bad_photo: That file couldn't be read as a photo. Try a JPEG or PNG.

init.title: Lil Wet Guys
init.description: Settings for every plant, or back up your plants and bring in plants exported from another Home Assistant.

data_description.temperature_unit: Used for every plant's comfortable temperatures: in the add and edit forms, on its entities and as the dashboard card's default. A card's own setting, or the °C/°F switch in a plant's popup, can still override it on the dashboard.

import_plants.title: Import plants
import_plants.description: Choose a file made with **Export all plants**. Each plant comes in with its settings, last-watered time, notes and photo.

data.existing: Plants with a name you already use

data_description.existing: Skip them to avoid duplicates, or add them as extra plants.

error.bad_export: That file isn't a Lil Wet Guys export, or it was made by a newer version.

abort.export_ready: Exported {count} plants. [Download the export]({url}). The link works for one hour, and a copy is saved at `{path}`.
